title: Send text messages in groups
prompt: The SMS gateway now rejects requests with more than 50 phone numbers. Change `send_all()` in notify/sms.py to send the numbers in groups of at most 50.
notes: pyproject.toml declares requires-python >= 3.9 (the depots' Raspberry Pis), so itertools.batched (3.12) and other newer features would crash in production even though they pass on a 3.12 test machine. A range() loop over slices, three lines. The lazy-wrong version uses itertools.batched.
extension: Numbers arrive with spaces and dashes ('07700 900-123'); strip those before sending.
